rows.doc: The chronicle posts facts at this weight and above.
Lines a day's chronicle post holds before "and N more" (GDD 12.7).
A season's length in world days (GDD 12.6); the weather keeps world.params season-days.
Season zero's length, the closed test's season, its bands scaled from season-days (GDD 12.6).
A character who acted within this many world days counts toward an arc's marks (GDD 12.2).
A mark counts at least this many active characters, so an unattended arc lapses rather than winning at 0. Provisional.
The shortest region or personal stage (GDD 12.2).
The longest region or personal stage (GDD 12.2).
A side's escrow is its mark's worth at this share (GDD 12.2, 12.3). Provisional.
The share of its escrow a side that did not win pays its backers, by how much of its mark they filled (GDD 12.2: both pay). Provisional.
A side's escrow is at most this share of that day's faucet budgets in the arc's regions (GDD 10.2). Provisional.
One point of a won beat's score is worth this much toward a side's escrow. Provisional.
Coin's worth backed per +1 standing with the sponsor (GDD 12.3).
Coin's worth backed per -1 standing with the opponent (GDD 12.3).
A character at or below this standing with a side's sponsor may not back it (GDD 5.4).
Ambush chance on a Marked character inside its arc's regions or the opposing sponsor's (GDD 5.5). Provisional.
Facts this heavy or heavier enter the director's memory ring.
Facts the director's memory ring keeps at most.
A fact leaves the memory ring after this many world days; predicates ask the ledger this far back (GDD 12.2).
Personal thread candidates waiting at most.
An ended arc stays in the story this long, for cards and the recap.
A raid's defence mark per active character of the settlement (GDD 12.10).
Defence a keeper-run settlement counts toward every trouble's mark. Provisional.
Condition a keeper-run settlement mends on every structure a world day. Provisional.
A chartered settlement that loses this many troubles in a season falls to ruin (GDD 4.8). Provisional.
A corruption front is a region over its line with this many neighbours over it. Provisional.
Corruption a lapsed front spreads to a neighbour a world day. Provisional.
World days a lapsed front spreads for. Provisional.
A region is cold on a day this share of its tiles is under frost. Provisional.
Cold days running that make a cold snap (GDD 12.9).
Regions a cold snap spans (GDD 12.9).
A region is wet on a day this share of its tiles is under wet weather. Provisional.
Wet days running that bring sickness (GDD 12.5).
Scarcity above which a wet streak brings sickness (GDD 12.5).
Scarcity falling below this opens a seam (GDD 12.5).
Stock a seam adds to the nearest node. Provisional.
How far from the place a seam finds its node. Provisional.
A faction starving this many world days running is collapsing. Provisional.
Until roads, a place's tile with this many passages a season counts as a road in. Provisional.
A caravan's bids are at most this share of the place's day budget. Provisional.
A caravan bids this share of the reference price, for the next tier's materials. Provisional.
Market fees at a raided place while the raid's stake runs (GDD 12.5: fees double).
What faction orders at a place in shortage pay, as a share of their price, while its stake runs. Provisional.
Rest and repair take this share of their time and cost while sickness runs (GDD 12.5: twice as long).
Two settlements this close can be rival seats (GDD 12.9).
A rival seat raised a structure within this many world days. Provisional.
A notable under this loyalty wavers (factions.params defect-below).
A betrayal this recent can cast a grudge (GDD 12.2's 30 world days).
A leading notable's death this recent can cast a succession (GDD 12.2's 30 world days).
Away this long before a return is cast (GDD 12.9).
Standing at which a faction's notables offer threads (GDD 5.4).
A personal thread's mark, for its one character (GDD 12.2's 25).
Pressure added to a region the world arc's lapse struck when the finale is cast. Provisional.
Pressure per trouble a settlement lost this season when the finale is cast. Provisional.
The least threat a wrong pattern attempt surges at its centre (GDD 4.13). Provisional.
The most threat a wrong pattern attempt surges at its centre (GDD 4.13). Provisional.
Salt delivered to set a beacon. Provisional.
How far out a chained pattern is placed from the one that opened it (GDD 4.13's offset).
Bearings tried before a chained pattern is not placed. Provisional.
Defence a running Stocked wall adds to a raid (settlements.guild-works stocked-wall).
Threads a faction's notables may have offered at once, pending or running, whatever the population (GDD 5.4). Provisional.
Offered threads a faction may add per thousand active characters. Provisional.
A character whose offered thread left the queue uncast is offered none for this many world days. Provisional.
